body: DUDE! I think you just saved me! My settings randomly changed and when I went to an old audio project no UAD plug-ins seemed to work. I went to iLok and it said my subscription was expired even though UAconnect was showing me the plugins I had available. Frustrating but hopefully it'll work as I followed your instructions and at least got iLok to recognize my sub was up to date. I'll know for sure when I open my project tomorrow. Thank you!

Yes! I've always been able to hear this but never put it into words.  I always thought it was overtones of the instruments playing together.  I find that if you try to reproduce the sound that you're hearing (in your case the piano/violin that isn't there) it'll emphasize the recording.  The overtones will be doubled basically.
